paragraphs.source_en: Lykos is dark at night. Lights all turned down so the Reds don’t go mad from eternal day. Somewhere, the nightshifts weave silks, mine soil. But here in this wide tunnel, there is no motion, no sound except the murmur of HCs showing old terraforming holos and the hum of distant machines. It is cool here, yet I sweat.

paragraphs.source_en: Mustang is silent beside me. She has not spoken since we descended in our gravBoots to the Common’s floor, ghostCloaks making us nearly invisible to the lingering drunks slumped over tables and sleeping soundly on the gallows steps. I hear the tension in her silence and wonder what she thinks.

paragraphs.source_en: My heart runs wild in my chest, so loud Mustang has to hear it as we enter Lambda Township, where I grew from boy to man. The place is smaller. The ceiling lower. Rope bridges and pulley systems like children’s toys. The HC that once glowed with Octavia au Lune’s face is an ancient relic, pixels missing. Mustang peers around, cloak deactivated. Her eyes dance from bridge to bridge to home like she’s seeing something wonderful. It didn’t occur to me a Gold would ever find interest in a simple place like this.

paragraphs.source_en: I climb the stone steps to the bridge that leads to my old home just like I did as a boy. Only, my limbs are too large now. I forgot I had gravBoots. Mustang doesn’t use hers either. She follows behind and dusts off her hands as she makes the landing where the thin metal door to my old family home has been cut into the wall.

I forgot I had gravBoots.
Mustang doesn’t use hers either.
She follows behind and dusts off her hands as she makes the landing where the thin metal door to my old family home has been cut into the wall.

paragraphs.source_en: “Darrow,” she says so quietly, “how do you know where you’re going?”

units.source_en: “Darrow,” she says so quietly, “how do you know where you’re going?”
My hands tremble.

paragraphs.source_en: “You told me to let you in.” I look down at her.

units.source_en: “You told me to let you in.”

“I did, but …”

paragraphs.source_en: “How far do you want to go?”

units.source_en: “How far do you want to go?”

paragraphs.source_en: I know she feels what’s coming. I wonder how long she’s felt it. The strangeness of me. The odd mannerisms. The distant soul.

paragraphs.source_en: She looks at her hands, stained red from the dust of the stone stairs. “All the way.”

paragraphs.source_en: I hand her a holoCube. “If you mean that, press play, and come in when you’ve finished watching. If you leave, I understand.”

paragraphs.source_en: I kiss her one last time, hard. She clutches at my hair, sensing that when we part, something will be different. I find myself pulling back. My hand cups her jaw. Her eyes, closed, begin to flutter open as I step away and turn to the door.
